kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-express-connect-traffic-qos-queue --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --queue-id-list qos-queue-9nyx2u7n71s2rc0000 --queue-name-list qos-queue-test --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The collection of QoS queue IDs
parameters.name: queue_id_list

parameters.help_en: The collection of QoS queue names
parameters.name: queue_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The QoS policy ID returned by the CreateExpressConnectTrafficQos operation.

This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the IllegalParam.QosId (400) error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略ID，由CreateExpressConnectTrafficQos接口返回。

该参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务返回IllegalParam.QosId（400）
parameters.name: qos_id

BandwidthPercent.description_en:
The bandwidth percentage of the QoS queue.

When the QoS queue type is Medium, this field is required. Valid values: 1 to 100.

When the QoS queue type is Default, this field is "-"
BandwidthPercent.description_zh:
QoS队列带宽百分比。

当QoS队列类型为Medium的时候，此字段必须输入，取值范围为：1~100。

当QoS队列类型为Default的时候，此字段为"-"

QueueDescription.description_en:
The description of the QoS queue.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
QueueDescription.description_zh:
QoS队列的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头

QueueName.description_en:
The name of the QoS queue.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
QueueName.description_zh:
QoS队列的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头

QueueType.description_en:
The QoS queue type. Valid values:

High: high-priority queue.

Medium: medium-priority queue.

Default: default-priority queue.

The default-priority queue cannot be created
QueueType.description_zh:
QoS队列类型，取值：

High：高优先级队列。

Medium：普通优先级队列。

Default：默认优先级队列。

默认优先级队列无法创建

DstCidr.description_en:
The destination IP address IPv4 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcIPv6Cidr or DstIPv6Cidr
DstCidr.description_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配目的IPv4网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcIPv6Cidr或DstIPv6Cidr

DstIPv6Cidr.description_en:
The destination IP address IPv6 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcCidr or DstCidr
DstIPv6Cidr.description_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配目的IPv6网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcCidr或DstCidr

DstPortRange.description_en:
The destination port range for traffic matching in the QoS rule. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A value of -1 indicates that no matching is performed. Only a single port number can be specified. The start and end port numbers must be the same. The destination port range is fixed for different protocol types. Valid values:

ALL: -1/-1, not editable.

ICMP(IPv4): -1/-1, not editable.

ICMPv6(IPv6): -1/-1, not editable.

TCP: -1/-1, editable.

UDP: -1/-1, editable.

GRE: -1/-1, not editable.

SSH: 22/22, not editable.

Telnet: 23/23, not editable.

HTTP: 80/80, not editable.

HTTPS: 443/443, not editable.

MS SQL: 1443/1443, not editable.

Oracle: 1521/1521, not editable.

MySql: 3306/3306, not editable.

RDP: 3389/3389, not editable.

PostgreSQL: 5432/5432, not editable.

Redis: 6379/6379, not editable
DstPortRange.description_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配目的端口号范围。取值范围：0~65535，如果不匹配时取值为-1。当前只支持指定单个端口号，端口号的起始和终止需要相同。不同的协议类型，对应的目的端口号范围是固定的，取值如下：

ALL：-1/-1，不可编辑。

ICMP(IPv4)：-1/-1，不可编辑。

ICMPv6(IPv6)：-1/-1，不可编辑。

TCP：-1/-1，可编辑。

UDP：-1/-1，可编辑。

GRE：-1/-1，不可编辑。

SSH：22/22，不可编辑。

Telnet：23/23，不可编辑。

HTTP：80/80，不可编辑。

HTTPS：443/443，不可编辑。

MS SQL：1443/1443，不可编辑。

Oracle：1521/1521，不可编辑。

MySql：3306/3306，不可编辑。

RDP：3389/3389，不可编辑。

PostgreSQL：5432/5432，不可编辑。

Redis：6379/6379，不可编辑

MatchDscp.description_en: The DSCP value for traffic matching in the QoS rule. Valid values: 0 to 63. A value of -1 indicates that no matching is performed
MatchDscp.description_zh: QoS规则匹配流量的DSCP值。取值范围：0~63，如果不匹配时取值为-1

Priority.description_en: The priority of the QoS rule. Valid values: 1 to 9000. A larger value indicates a higher priority. The priority of each QoS rule must be unique within the same QoS policy
Priority.description_zh: QoS规则优先级。取值范围：1~9000，数字越大优先级越高，在同一个QoS策略内QoS规则优先级不允许重复

Protocol.description_en:

ALL

ICMP(IPv4)

ICMPv6(IPv6)

TCP

UDP

SSH

Telnet

HTTP

HTTPS

MS SQL

Oracle

MySql

RDP

TCP

RemarkingDscp.description_en: The DSCP value to remark in the traffic. Valid values: 0 to 63. A value of -1 indicates that no remarking is performed
RemarkingDscp.description_zh: 修改流量中的DSCP值。取值范围：0~63，如果不修改时取值为-1

RuleDescription.description_en:
The description of the QoS rule.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
RuleDescription.description_zh:
QoS规则的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头

RuleName.description_en:
The name of the QoS rule.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
RuleName.description_zh:
QoS规则的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头

SrcCidr.description_en:
The source IPv4 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcIPv6Cidr or DstIPv6Cidr
SrcCidr.description_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配源IPv4网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcIPv6Cidr或DstIPv6Cidr

SrcIPv6Cidr.description_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcCidr or DstCidr
SrcIPv6Cidr.description_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配源IPv6网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcCidr或DstCidr

SrcPortRange.description_en: The source port range for traffic matching in the QoS rule. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A value of -1 indicates that no matching is performed. Only a single port number can be specified. The start and end port numbers must be the same
SrcPortRange.description_zh: QoS规则流量匹配源端口号范围，取值范围：0~65535，当不匹配时取值为-1。当前只支持指定单个端口号，端口号的起始和终止需要相同

Status.description_en:
The status of the QoS rule. Valid values:

Normal: available.

Configuring: being configured.

Deleting: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
QoS规则的状态。取值：

Normal：可用。

Configuring：配置中。

Deleting：删除中

Status.description_en:
The status of the QoS queue. Valid values:

Normal: available.

Configuring: being configured.

Deleting: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
QoS队列的状态。取值：

Normal：可用。

Configuring：配置中。

Deleting：删除中
